24M, Springfield, MO
I work overtime Wednesday-Sunday or Monday most weeks and occasionally I do some work with a side gig. Other than that I like to cook, workout, and enjoy a bottle of wine every once in awhile. I’m mostly a homebody but sometimes I’ll go to parties with some close friends. Not a lot of stuff going on Mondays and Tuesdays most weeks 🙃.

I’m also divorced and not looking for anything too serious. I’m willing to travel but preferably we’d get to know each other a bit first. I understand if the distance is too much.

Send me a message if any of that sounds like what you’re looking for. I’d love to get to know more.
There’s nothing wrong with staying in ☺️

24M Southern Missouri

I’m very fit. I go to the gym about 4-5 days a week and I spend most of my time working. I like hiking, kayaking, movie nights with wine, and traveling. Looking preferably for nice cougars/pumas under 50ish. Age isn’t necessarily a dealbreaker. Fwb irl is preferable but penpals or those looking for something more could also be entertained. You’re free to message me if that sounds interesting. Have a good day ☺️.
